dataSource.notes: Official Subway 'U.S. Nutrition Information' PDF (January 2026 edition), linked as 'Nutrition Data Tables (USA)' from https://www.subway.com/en-us/menunutrition/nutrition. All build-your-own components use the 6-inch sandwich basis from the 'Breads & Ingredients' tables: breads are per 6-inch roll/wrap; proteins are the 6-inch sandwich meat portion; cheeses, vegetables, and sauces are the 'amount on 6-inch sandwich' portion (per the PDF, double all values for a footlong, and double sauce values for a salad dressing portion). Extras are per stated serving (1 cookie = 45 g, etc.). Excluded because they do not appear in the January 2026 official document: Italian Herbs & Cheese bread, Honey Oat bread, Mozzarella cheese, Light Mayonnaise, Chipotle Southwest sauce, classic Sweet Onion sauce, classic Ranch, and bagged chips (not listed in the PDF). Drinks, kids meals, soups, and curated/pre-built subs are intentionally excluded (components only). Zero-calorie seasonings (salt, pepper, oregano) omitted.
